description:
Remember the tiger-head bag that recently caught online attention?
In Qingyang, Gansu Province, tiger-head sachets and other handmade designs show how Chinese folk traditions are being reimagined with modern colors, playful styles and centuries-old craftsmanship.
title: From viral tiger-head bag to Qingyang's handmade sachets

author: New China TV
description:
A group of students from Harvard and MIT recently concluded a nine-day trip to China. "The best way to understand a country is by being there, with its people," they said.
The visit is part of a U.S.-China initiative to bring 50,000 young Americans to China for study and exchange.
title: U.S. students highlight people-to-people exchange during China trip

author: New China TV
description:
The three astronauts of the Shenzhou-21 crewed mission have all left the return capsule of the Shenzhou-22 spaceship, and they are in good health condition, setting a new record for the longest stay in space by a Chinese astronaut crew.
The return capsule, carrying astronauts Zhang Lu, Wu Fei and Zhang Hongzhang, touched down at the Dongfeng landing site in north China's Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region on Friday.
title: Shenzhou-21 astronauts out of return capsule in good health

author: New China TV
description:
The Zijing Night Market in the Economic Development Zone of Nanchang, east China's Jiangxi Province, opens on time every evening at 5:30 p.m., with more than 300 stalls sizzling in business. 
This popular night market, which originated with a dozen scattered stalls 18 years ago, now boasts an annual turnover of over 100 million yuan (13.8 million U.S. dollars), a landmark of the city's night economy.
What the Zijing Night Market offers is not only a low-threshold starting point for entrepreneurs, but also a great place for citizens to relax and unwind. xhtxs.cn/bcB4
title: EconomyInFocus | Red-hot secrets of a viral night market in Jiangxi
